title: Capcom confirms data breach impacting 11.7 million users
excerpt: Capcom has confirmed a security breach affecting 11.7 million users, warning that affected individuals may experience more phishing emails.
body_html: Game developer Capcom has confirmed that a recent data breach has impacted 11.7 million users. While the Capcom ID service remains available for use, the company warns that affected individuals could see an increase in phishing scam emails as a result of the incident.
